verdict.rationale: Postman documents a native 'Collection format' for designing/sharing APIs and community recalls Postman's stated goal of 'simple JSON based data formats which can be exported and shared,' with one user manually restoring a JSON backup — suggesting portable export/import exists. However, multiple community reports describe friction moving data between environments: forced cloud sign-in to migrate collections to a new machine, lock-in pushing users toward per-seat cloud subscriptions for sharing, and cases of local collections being wiped rather than easily exported.
